channel.title: Sonneblom Digitaal: South African Gifts

item.title: Lekker T-Shirt
item.description: 'Lekker': the one Afrikaans word every South African knows. A soft cotton tee with a hand-drawn sunflower.

item.title: Ubuntu T-Shirt
item.description: Ubuntu: 'Umuntu ngumuntu ngabantu', 'Ek is omdat ons is', 'I am because we are', in isiZulu, Afrikaans and English.

item.title: Braaimeester T-Shirt
item.description: 'Braaimeester. Ek braai, dus ek is.' For the one who always runs the fire. Great for Father's Day and Braai Day.

item.title: Suid-Afrikaans in Murg en Been T-Shirt
item.description: 'Suid-Afrikaans in murg en been': South African to the bone, wherever in the world you live.

item.title: Klein Sonneblom Kids T-Shirt
item.description: 'Klein Sonneblom' (little sunflower): a cheerful Afrikaans tee for little ones.

item.title: Beste Ouma in die Wêreld Mug
item.description: 'Beste Ouma in die wêreld' (best grandma in the world). An Afrikaans mug for the ouma who has everything.

item.title: Beste Oupa in die Wêreld Mug
item.description: 'Beste Oupa in die wêreld' (best grandpa in the world). An Afrikaans mug for oupa's coffee and beskuit.

item.title: Koffie en Beskuit Mug
item.description: Koffie en beskuit is my love language. For every South African who dunks a rusk in their morning coffee.

item.title: Eish Nog Maandag Mug
item.description: Eish! Nog Maandag (another Monday). A funny South African mug for the office.

item.title: Morabaraba Board Poster
item.description: A printed Morabaraba board: the cattle game of Southern Africa. Hang it on the wall, or lay it flat and play with 12 stones each.

item.title: Afrikaanse Alfabet Poster
